Status measured for the behaviour (client 16.402: a Lava Pup's swing at a Goblin 2,393 past reach made no projectile, both seats; 1,259 launches within 633 past), not for its threshold: this key brackets it only to (633, 2,393] past reach, and the 1,500 is HIT_BEYOND_CANCEL_RANGE's (its hit half measured (1,149, 1,507]); the ledger's open item names the band and its promotion rule asks for a launch observed inside it. On the 16.402 corpus by override: 20260920-071744-A +359 within and to the bar, -B +307; the 15.535 populations 0 moved. No harness line (the key was never per client); tests/launch_beyond_cancel.rs pins the shipped arm. The serde default stays launched (a snapshot saved before the key).

Both clients' own pending_damage leaves a non-homing shot out: with only such shots in flight at a unit it read 0 on 2,590 of 2,689 16.402 corpus frames (pending_homing_census16402.py) and 2,309 of 2,532 15.535.29 scenario frames (pending_homing_census15535.py); a homing shot alone showed in it on 5,550 of 5,551 and 14,611 of 14,827 (the rest are shots the records file under another card: a Fire Spirit's leap under its hut, a tower arrow with no target). 20260918-115249.b1 t3013: a Bomber's bomb left for a Goblin Hut on 75 hp; the client's Hut read pending 0, its three Archers kept it and killed it on t3022, and the Bomber (its victim doomed by their homing arrows) walked on t3023; the engine counted the bomb, its Archers dropped the Hut on t3014 and walked, the bomb killed it on t3023 and the Bomber waited six ticks (the battle's first divergence, t3101; 734 unit-ticks). replay_parity runs a 15.535.29 capture at the new arm; proposed to ship it on both clients. Plant doomed_set_counts_every_shot; test doomed_set_shots

sim: combat.LAUNCH_BEYOND_CANCEL_RANGE (new): launched (shipped, the engine's: every due launch of a projectile attacker is made, wherever its target stands) or not_launched (the projectile half of combat.HIT_BEYOND_CANCEL_RANGE: a launch whose target stands more than targeting.LOGIC_CANCEL_HIT_FROM_LONG_DISTANCE_RANGE past the attacker's reach, Range + both radii on the fire tick's start positions, is not made; the attack cycle runs on, the load timer reset as on a launch, and the target is kept; crown towers, kamikazes, selector cards and evolved forms launch as before; combat.rs fire `cancelled`). Client 16.402 (launch_cancel_census16402.py over the corpus recordings, a due fire read as the load timer rising on a whole HitSpeed cycle with the target held): 1,259 due launches made (a battle's two seats counted apart), every one within reach + 633; not made 1, seen from both seats: 20260920-071744 t1983, Lava Pup 59's swing at Goblin 69 4,943 off (2,393 past its reach of 2,550), its load timer reset and no projectile, the Goblin's pending damage 0 and its hp 40 to the end. The engine launched: its shot killed the Goblin on t1995 and the other pups, the Goblin doomed by it, took the red King on t1984 where the client's chased the Goblin (the battle's first divergence, t1992; 791 and 611 unit-ticks). Client 15.535.29 (launch_cancel_census15535.py): launches up to 1,191 past reach, none due past 1,500, so the clients are not separated. LOW: one swing; the bracket (1,191, 2,393] holds 1,500, as HIT_BEYOND_CANCEL_RANGE's direct-hit bracket does. Proposed to ship not_launched on both clients. Plant launch_beyond_cancel_launched; test launch_beyond_cancel

The bomb rows are BUILDING rows (IsBuilding, DeployTime 3000 the fuse), as the Skeleton King's souls already read them (soul_point_refused). Not the dead building's footprint: routes cross a dead building's cells from the next tick (dead_footprint_census.py). replay_parity runs a 15.535.29 capture at the new arm. Plant death_bomb_never_blocks; test death_bomb_obstacle

sim: combat.RANDOM_DELAY_STREAM ships client15535_battle_stream on both clients (Sim's ruling on parity's r40 proposal, 2026-10-04): a RandomDelay shot's delay (the Hunter's pellets, the only RandomDelay rows) draws from the client's battle generator (state.rs client_draw), one draw a pellet in the fan's order and one more before the next, on client 16.402 as on 15.535.29. Client 16.402 records no generator, so it was recovered from the pellets (parity's rng_recover / rng_back, a brute force over all 2^32 states): in 20260920-082459 one chain fits all 9 Hunter volleys' holds, each volley's state the previous one's after 19, 19, 19, 19, 71, 23, 59 and 27 draws (t1824 .. t3788; t1912 from 3561149559, t2147 from 3344999008), where about 4,000 states fit any one volley alone. A scratch fixture with that chain as its rng column, scored at this arm: the t1912 volley exact and the Hunter walking on t1922 in both (t1923 before). Where no generator is recorded the arm draws the client's way from the engine's seed; no recovered column is written for the corpus (Sim's ruling: revisit with several Hunter battles). The 5 hash_continuity battles fire no Hunter. The harness's 15.535 arm line goes (the default now); the 16.402 pin in tests/replay_parity.rs moves; tests/random_delay_stream.rs pins the shipped arm and keeps the old arm's check. The serde default stays engine_own (a snapshot saved before the key).

The harness's 15.535 arm line goes (the default now); the 16.402 pin in tests/replay_parity.rs moves; tests/pellet_building_reach.rs pins the shipped arm. sim: combat.NET_LAUNCH (new, per client): extra_and_wait (shipped, the engine's: an Evo Hunter's net starts ProjectileStartRadius plus its ProjectileStartExtraRadius from him and, thrown in the Projectile phase after the tick's shots stepped, waits a tick before its first step) or client15535_edge_next_tick (it starts his collision radius plus the net's ProjectileStartExtraRadius from him, 600 + 200 = 800 where the engine's ProjectileStartRadius 1,000 + 200 = 1,200, and first steps on the next tick; state.rs throw_net `client`). Client 15.535.29 (the raw frames' projectiles of sp-f4-hunterG0-s0, -G40-s0 and -G80-s0 beside the debug exe's dump): the client's net first seen 800 from him on all three (the engine's 1,200) and 600 on along its line on the next frame; G40 landed on the engine's tick (t1022, the extra 400 making up for the wait), G80 a tick before it (thrown 450 short: the client's landed t1059 and its Golem stood from t1060, the engine's t1060 with its Golem stepping on t1060, the scene's net hold a tick late). G0's throw came 2 ticks later in the client (another rule, open). replay_parity runs a 15.535.29 capture at the new arm. Plant net_launch_extra_and_wait; test net_launch

sim: targeting.LAUNCH_BEYOND_POSITION (new, per client): start_of_tick (shipped, the engine's: a projectile attacker's launch is judged against its reach on the launch tick's start positions, and one from beyond ends the hold past reach on the next tick) or client15535_after_move (for a crown tower the launch is flagged and judged on the next tick's start positions, its target where the launch tick's move left it, against its plain reach; beyond it, the hold ends and the tower rescans; state.rs phase_attack_for, target.rs decide `launched_out`, `launch_judged_after_move`). Client 15.535.29 (tower_band_census.py, every crown tower fire tick whose target stood past Range + both radii by at most 500 at the tick's end): the tower let go on the next tick 59 of 59, 8 of them inside reach at the tick's start, which the engine kept (held to reach + 500); none past at the start came back inside. sp-esk-bank-16500-s1 t953: Blue's right tower shot a Skeleton 8,971 off (reach 9,000) that stepped to 9,003; the client's tower took an Evo Skeleton on t954 with its progress running on, the engine's kept the Skeleton, idled 3 ticks and loosed its next arrow 3 ticks late, which let the Evo Skeleton live (514 lost). replay_parity runs a 15.535.29 capture at the new arm. Plant launch_judged_on_launch_tick; test launch_beyond_position

sim: combat.EVO_CHAIN_HOP_FIRST_STEP (new, per client): next_tick (shipped, the engine's: an Evo Electro Dragon's hop, released where its shot or the hop before it landed, first steps on the next tick, as every released shot does) or client15535_creation_tick (it takes its first step in the same Projectile pass as the landing that released it, so a first hop within a step of its target lands on its shot's tick and a later hop's wait counts that tick; and so does every hop those steps release; combat.rs step_projectiles: the pass's closure named `step`, `released` in a RefCell, the tick's Evo hops stepped again until none is left). Client 15.535.29 (the debug exe's projectile dump of sp-f4-ed3-s0 and sp-f4-ed-s0 beside the client's hitpoint drops): sp-f4-ed3-s0 t1163, the shot on a Knight and its first hop on an Ice Golem 1,201 off (a step is 2,000) both landed on t1163, the engine's hop on t1164; the second hop on the Valkyrie 3,100 on landed t1166 (waits on t1163 and t1164, then two steps), the engine's t1168; sp-f4-ed-s0 t1163, a first hop more than a step off landed t1164, the engine's t1165; from there the engine's chains run 1 to 5 ticks late (754 and 235 lost). The base dragon's chains are exact under both arms. replay_parity runs a 15.535.29 capture at the new arm. Plant evo_hop_steps_next_tick; test evo_chain_hop_first_step

sim: knockback.LADDER_PATH_REQUEST (new, per client): ladder_end (shipped, the engine's: a pushback tick asks for no path, so a unit holding none plans when its ladder ends, from where the ladder leaves it) or client15535_on_ladder (on each ladder tick a unit whose target, or default tower, is out of its reach, not deploying and not held by its attack, a stun or a freeze, takes the replan gate's goal cell from where it stands before the tick's step and plans, the gate's search, when it holds no route or that cell moved, a new target; a route whose goal cell holds rides out the ladder as it is; the ladder still takes the step; state.rs phase_path16402_for, the pushback tick's `asks` block). Client 15.535.29 (ladder_plan_census.py, every knockback ladder in the records, its path length before, through and after it and its state): of the units holding no route going in that planned while reading walking, 87 of 111 planned on their first walking frame (24 later: Sparky recoils 2 to 4 frames on, Ice Golemites at the end); 25 walked with no plan, 29 never walked (deploying, attacking through it); units holding a route kept it or its suffix 178 of 185. sp-champ-Monk-nopress-s0 t252: a Knight attacking the Monk, knocked back by his hit, read walking with a 1-cell route from t253 and at the ladder's end (t265) stepped (-32, -50) along it, where the engine's, no route through the ladder, planned 2 cells there and stepped (15, -57): the scene's first divergence (176 lost). sp-form-Bowler-hero-nopress-s0 t223-t234: a Musketeer knocked out of its attack read a 1-cell route on t224 and, its target switched to a tower on t228, a 14-cell one from there, walked on at the ladder's end, where the engine's planned 13 cells at the end and stepped (39, -45) for the client's (48, -35). MEDIUM-LOW: the 24 later plans are not explained; the batch's isolation decides. replay_parity runs a 15.535.29 capture at the new arm. Plant ladder_plans_at_end; test ladder_path_request
